title: Tarakasi silver filigree
summary: Twist silver wire into a round medallion: a frame of twisted wire, six petals with curls inside, buds between them and tiny balls of silver on top.
howToPlay: The framed picture shows the finished piece.
Tap a colour to dip the tool. Press and drag to lay the line; follow the lit guide.
Where a step has shapes, tap a shape to fill it with enamel.
Press Next or Check when a step is done.
rules: Score: how closely your wire follows the guide, and how many of the granules sit where they belong.
Wire laid away from the guide counts against you; undo takes back the last stroke.
Wire counts for the lines and the granules; enamel counts for how much of each cell holds the right colour.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn makes a whole piece for you.
heritageNote: Tarakasi is the silver filigree of Cuttack in Odisha. Fine silver wire is twisted, flattened and curled into lacework, soldered into a frame and finished with small granules.
